description: This is a wiring schematic for an electrical system, detailing the connections between various components. The schematic includes a main switchboard, breakers, touch screen interfaces, thermostats, MRMAX units for different cabins, and a TMD bridge. A legend is provided for the different cables and buses used in the system, and several detailed connection diagrams for specific components are shown on the right side of the main schematic.
